minor.issue: Response emits two cookie-clear directives inside a single Set-Cookie header separated by commas (`dz_token=; ... , dz_session_token=; ...`) which the Python `requests` library merges/mis-parses. curl and browsers still clear cookies correctly, and /api/auth/me returns 401 after logout, so functionally unaffected. Consider emitting two separate Set-Cookie headers for cleaner behaviour with non-browser HTTP clients.
